model.name: Remove the MODEL_STORE_SOURCE write-flag + its MODEL_READ_SOURCE alias — one store, no switch (the 'rollback lever' is a split-brain data-loss footgun, not a rollback)
model.description: Tester EVIDENCE (isolated rig): with flag=model-store a model write lands ONLY in data/model-store (DRAINED) and is ABSENT from scenario/index where reads resolve -> on any bare restart / lost .env / flip back to default, that write is LOST (data written where nothing reads). The R40.81 close recorded model-store as an 'explicit rollback lever' — PO's wording, WRONG: reads ignore the flag entirely, so it cannot roll anything back; it only MISROUTES writes. It is a SPLIT-BRAIN SWITCH and a documented rollback that cannot roll back is a footgun someone reaches for in an incident. REQUIREMENT: remove the flag + its transitional MODEL_READ_SOURCE alias; one store, no switch.

discoverySource.rig: isolated rig: flag=model-store -> write to drained model-store, absent from scenario/index, lost on restart/lost-.env/flip-back

model.crossRefNote: Completes the ONE-STORE (R40.81 root): R40.102 removed the READER toggle (reads hardwired to one store); THIS removes the residual WRITE flag MODEL_STORE_SOURCE + the MODEL_READ_SOURCE alias = no store-choice anywhere, write-side + alias. The split-brain was: reads already ignore the flag (R40.102), but writes still obeyed it = writes misrouted to a store nothing reads.
model.queuePriority: AFTER the current Sprint 41 increment (PO rank): a real data-loss footgun but only fires if someone SETS the flag, so it does NOT preempt Tron's ordered sprint. Boarded so it cannot drift.

acceptanceCriteria.text: NO code path can route a model write anywhere but scenario/index — there is exactly ONE write sink. Re-introduce a store-choice (any flag/param selecting a write target) => RED. (Fixes the demonstrated footgun: flag=model-store wrote to the DRAINED data/model-store, absent from scenario/index where reads resolve = silent data loss on restart / lost .env / flip-back.)

gateRef.assertion: every model write lands in scenario/index; a code path routing a model write to model-store (or any alt store) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: re-introduce a store-choice that routes a model write to data/model-store -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The MODEL_STORE_SOURCE flag AND its transitional MODEL_READ_SOURCE alias are REMOVED — 0 references in code, env-readers, config, or scripts. One store, no switch. A residual reference to either => RED.

gateRef.assertion: grep MODEL_STORE_SOURCE / MODEL_READ_SOURCE across code+scripts+config == 0; any residual => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: leave a MODEL_STORE_SOURCE or MODEL_READ_SOURCE reference anywhere -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The R40.81-close framing of model-store as an 'explicit rollback lever' is CORRECTED on record: reads IGNORE the flag entirely, so it could never roll anything back — it only MISROUTED writes (split-brain switch). Removing it loses NO rollback capability; rollback is the git pre-image, not this flag. A doc/req still calling it a rollback lever => RED.

gateRef.assertion: no doc/req describes MODEL_STORE_SOURCE as a rollback mechanism; rollback = git pre-image

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: leave a doc claiming the flag is a rollback lever -> RED
